name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2521: A1 has said for several versions that FLOWING is 0 because no lane scorer exists. Measured what a scorer could honestly be built on: only 2 of 11 watcher lanes have anything published under their name. And naming is not scoring - health_engine reports shadowWatch state ok while its own line says the shadow reader is switched OFF so nothing is watching for the game. Scoring FLOWING from that would report a switched-off lane as working, on the one surface whose purpose is saying which vessels are alive. Not built deliberately; the question of whether lanes should write a heartbeat is his.
